en.title: NVDA Downshift on Earnings Outlook
en.summary: The probability of NVIDIA shares being up on August 26 plummeted by 47.5% to 7%, driven by bearish analyst predictions and historical post-earnings performance. Sean Williams of Motley Fool specifically predicted a 5th consecutive quarterly fall.
drivers: Motley Fool's Sean Williams predicted a 5th consecutive NVDA share fall post-earnings.
NVDA has historically fallen after four straight earnings beats, suggesting a 'sell the news' trend.
Market believes a 96% earnings beat probability is already priced in, limiting upside.
en.why_matters: NVIDIA's post-earnings performance often sets the tone for the broader tech sector, especially for AI-related stocks, impacting investor confidence.
en.bull_case: Despite bearish sentiment, NVDA's strong underlying performance and recent intraday price rebound could still lead to an unexpected rise.
en.bear_case: A pattern of falling after earnings beats and a highly priced-in beat probability strongly suggest a further decline on August 26.
